Set PdfChemy as your default app to open PDF files

To make PdfChemy your default PDF viewer:

1. Open any PDF file from your file manager or downloads.
2. When prompted with "Open with", select PdfChemy.
3. Choose "Always" to open PDF documents with PdfChemy automatically.

You can also configure default app associations in Android Settings.
